_note: Words that are pack identifiers somewhere but mean something else in the core. Each needs a reason.
product: a metric type (ratio | sum | product); one pack also names a hierarchy 'product'
agent: the LLM agent that reads results (eval scoring, the MCP server, the skill), not a call-centre agent
location: generic English; also a hierarchy name in one pack
category: generic English; also a level name in one pack
network: generic English (network, as in a Toolbox server); also a level name in one pack
state: generic English and programming (build state, session state, a state machine); also a dimension name in one pack
issue: generic English and programming (a validation issue, an issue found); also a hierarchy level name in one pack
